description: This script provides an API for interacting with the Xbox REST API, including functions for managing packages, processes, files, and device info on a remote Xbox device. It also contains an interactive command-line tester for inspecting and controlling Xbox packages and processes.

classes.name: Xb1NetworkApi
classes.description: A class providing an interface for communicating with a remote Xbox device via REST API, including methods for retrieving device info, managing packages, processes, files, and user sessions.

methods.name: GetFilesRecursively
methods.description: Recursively collects all files in a directory and returns a dictionary mapping directory names to file paths.

methods.name: _PrintAndRaiseIfError
methods.description: Prints detailed error information and raises an HTTPError if the response status is not OK.

methods.name: InteractiveCommandLineMode
methods.description: Provides an interactive CLI to test and inspect Xbox device packages, processes, and settings.
